name: olio.pb.scene
label: Scene
description: One scene of a picture book, replacing the per-scene JSON blob held in a data.note. Scene order is the sceneIndex column rather than array position in a blob, so reordering is N patches. sceneIndex is deliberately NOT part of a unique constraint: reordering writes overlapping indices transiently, and a unique index would reject the intermediate state. The field is named sceneIndex rather than index because 'index' is not in DBUtil.reservedWords and would be emitted unquoted.

fields.name: sceneNode
fields.description: The workflow node that produces this scene's imagery. The scene's generation status is read from that node, not duplicated here.

fields.name: poemStanza
fields.description: For ChapBook scenes: the stanza text for this page. Separate from blurb (LLM-generated captions).

fields.name: sdPrompt
fields.description: For ChapBook scenes: landscape SD prompt derived from poemStanza + mood.

fields.name: imageObjectId
fields.description: For ChapBook scenes: objectId of the data.data image produced by ChapBook render. Used by bookPageView as the dataObjectId fallback when sceneNode is null.
